connector.name: GlianaAI
connector.registryDescription: Pay-per-call AI: 59 generative models (image, video, music, speech). No signup, no API key.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package gliana-ai-mcp. The credential requirement is not named, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the gliana-labs account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record marks at least one value as secret without naming the scheme. Read the source before you supply a credential.

env.name: GLIANA_WALLET_KEY
env.description: 0x EVM private key for a wallet holding USDC on Base/Tempo — enables the paid generate tool. Discovery tools work without it.

env.name: GLIANA_SOLANA_KEY
env.description: Solana secret key (base58 or JSON array) — enables paying with the solana rail.

env.name: GLIANA_RAIL
env.description: Payment rail for generate: base | tempo | solana (default base).

env.name: GLIANA_API_URL
env.description: Override the gateway base URL (default https://api.glianalabs.com).
